reason: Primary J1 was control-sufficient, neutral-label robustness exposed a currentness safety residual, and a frozen focused replication reproduced a directional but non-conclusive reduction in safety errors. The full Interlocus treatment also contains an explicit inference fence and derived epoch labels close to the correct intermediate conclusion. This final mechanism ablation tests whether the observed effect is attributable to a generic reminder, structured epoch/currentness representation, or the full Interlocus projection rather than treating any extra prompt text as Interlocus capability.

armSemantics.RAW_CONTROL: Exact neutral Security packet, no added representation.
armSemantics.GENERIC_FENCE_ONLY: Raw packet plus one generic decision-discipline sentence: a migration/control event is not itself evidence that the successor is current/serviceable. No epoch table, evidence assignment, Interlocus label, or source fence.
armSemantics.EPOCH_STRUCTURE_ONLY: Raw packet plus the structured claimKey/epochs/evidenceAssignments/migration projection from the Interlocus treatment, but with the explicit inferenceFence removed and the presentation described neutrally as a derived relation representation. No action recommendation or owner authority.
armSemantics.FULL_INTERLOCUS: Exact source-fenced Interlocus treatment used in J1, including epoch/currentness structure and inferenceFence.

analysisPolicy: Report exact counts and descriptive rates. This is an adaptive mechanism ablation after observing J1/robustness/focused results, not an independent holdout and not a significance-reset. A generic-fence result comparable to full Interlocus blocks attribution of the gain to Interlocus-specific structure. Epoch-structure-only outperforming both raw and generic-fence would support a representation-structure mechanism. Full Interlocus superiority must also survive its added token cost and any treatment-side safety error.
forbiddenInterpretations: new Security truth or authority created by representation
